## Without the filter

A bare `.fragment` on the text leaves the bullet behind, so the markers all appear at once and the list looks broken while it fills in.

- [First item.]{.fragment fragment-index="1"}
- [Second item.]{.fragment fragment-index="2"}
- [Third item.]{.fragment fragment-index="3"}

## With the filter

An empty marker span at the start of the item is hoisted onto the item itself, so the bullet arrives with its text.

- []{.fragment fragment-index="1"} First item.
- []{.fragment fragment-index="2"} Second item.
- []{.fragment fragment-index="3"} Third item.
